title: Highly sensitive evanescent wave SERS probe based on exposed-core optical fibers and its application
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,7987-7994
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08733J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Luping Meng, Guangqiang Liu, Zongying Feng
In this study, we developed a convenient and effective method for the fabrication of evanescent wave fiber surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) probes constructed with ordered silver nanocolumn arrays on the curved surface of an exposed core.
